title: Emrys and the Vow
author: Yara Voss
blurb: Coral Dravenmoor, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
